description: Sites de comptage vélo et piétons is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Rennes. Données complémentaires sur les sites de comptage vélo/piétons à Rennes. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are comptage. The portal shows 68 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-04-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
